notes.title: Ending Walkthrough & Demo Added
notes.content:
We've put up a simple ending walkthrough on the store page to show players how to get to each of the nine endings of the game! Remember one of the ideas we used in Orion was that when you, the player, go to different endings, it is the protagonist himself trying different decisions with his abilities. 

A demo of the game is also on the Store page.

Thank you for the feedback!

Ending Walkthrough: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B5znc6YqFiPhMEVzbmNhZTgxQjQ/view?usp=sharing

-- Reuben
